provenance: Reports were produced by real Playwright runs against www.saucedemo.com on 2026-10-18 using deliberately constructed tests (see eval/README.md). Labels are the author's ground truth based on how each failure was constructed. Local paths are replaced with <repo>/<home>.

cases.title: assertion-not-from-requirement
cases.label: assertion_logic
cases.acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid standard account, when the shopper signs in, then the product list titled "Products" is shown.
cases.rationale: The test expects "Our Products", which the criterion never states.

cases.title: product-defect-sort
cases.label: product_behavior
cases.acceptanceCriteria: Sorting by name Z to A lists "Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)" first.
cases.rationale: problem_user is an intentionally broken account on the demo site; its sorting does not work.

cases.title: locator-missing
cases.label: locator
cases.acceptanceCriteria: The product list is shown after sign-in.
cases.rationale: The test targets a data-test id that does not exist on the page.

cases.title: slow-login
cases.label: timeout_sync
cases.acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid account, when the shopper signs in, then the product list titled "Products" is shown.
cases.rationale: performance_glitch_user delays sign-in by several seconds; the 1s assertion timeout is too short. The element exists later.

cases.title: sign in as standard user
cases.label: test_data_setup
cases.rationale: The setup project ran with a wrong password, so authentication state could not be created.

cases.title: passes
cases.rationale: Did not run because its setup dependency failed; must not be reported as passed.
